critiques.speaker: Pierre
critiques.quote: "There is a patronus, a little white bunny running around it, though," he called out as he threw himself through the seam. "And I do not exactly know where that came from!"
critiques.comment: Great scene but the wiring is a little hard to follow this idea that Pierre instinctually cast up joking Harry Potter spell that almost kind of worked but didn't at all do anything

critiques.speaker: Theodore (Teddy)
critiques.quote: Teddy took the cold specimen with a furrowed brow, turning it under the sunlight. "Hair? I would not have called it that. I would call this some sort of synapse, or a brain nerve. Gross."

critiques.speaker: Mike
critiques.quote: "Well, we put the rum in the pancakes, and then we also put the rum in the jam," Mike answered cheerfully, leaning against the doorframe.
critiques.comment: And of course we also put rum in the rum

critiques.speaker: Eusacles
critiques.quote: "Pierre, make it a double for me," Eusacles groaned, leaning his head back against the timber wall. "I've had a hell of a night, and you did just stab me."
critiques.comment: The bones of the scene are fantastic, but the transitions and overall flow is pretty choppy

critiques.speaker: Pierre
critiques.quote: Pierre huffed, smoothing his coat. "I would like to do some spear practice before we leave."
critiques.comment: This is correct but doesn't correspond well to the actual transition which is I'm very intimidating or something to respond to what musically said so that the training montage can begin

critiques.speaker: Alfie
critiques.quote: "The training montage," Alfie cheered, hopping down onto the gravel path outside.
critiques.comment: The training montage is weird to say
